summary: This bill expresses support for recognizing September 29, 2025, as "International Day of Awareness of Food Loss and Waste" and acknowledges the importance of preventing food waste.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is purely symbolic, expressing support for a day of awareness. It does not authorize or appropriate any funds, nor does it direct any government agency to spend money. Therefore, it has no direct impact on government spending.

While the resolution mentions that better food distribution could feed hungry people and reduce the number of undernourished individuals, it does not propose any concrete policies or programs related to welfare or the social safety net. Its focus is on awareness of food loss and waste, not on direct aid or welfare expansion/reduction.
